author: Forbes
description:
What happens when a former Wall Street wealth manager trades the boardroom for reality TV — and then launches a financial wellness startup?

In this episode of Forbes Talks Shop, host Kim Peiffer sits down with Love Thy Nader star and Mary & Pip founder Mary Holland Nader to discuss her unconventional career path, from managing ultra-high-net-worth clients at Deutsche Bank to building a behavioral finance platform designed to make money less intimidating.

Mary shares the financial habits that keep her grounded, including her weekly "money ritual," the mindset shifts that helped her leave a stable finance career, and why she believes most people's money challenges are psychological—not informational. She also opens up about entrepreneurship, reality television, dating in New York, navigating imposter syndrome and building a business at the intersection of finance, fashion and media.

Along the way, she reveals the products and tools she can't live without—from red light therapy masks
title: From Wall Street to Reality TV: Mary Holland Nader's Next Act

author: Forbes
description:
How did America go from its first self-made millionaire in the 1780s to the possibility of the world's first trillionaire? In this Forbes deep dive, Assistant Managing Editor Chase Peterson-Withorn explores the history of extreme wealth—from early American fortunes to industrial giants like John D. Rockefeller and modern tech leaders such as Bill Gates and Elon Musk. Discover how wealth records have been repeatedly shattered, what drives today's unprecedented accumulation of wealth, and whether the world is entering a new era of trillionaire fortunes. Is there still a limit to how rich someone can become?

0:00 - The Birth of American Wealth (1780s)
0:57 - The Gilded Age & John D. Rockefeller
2:41 The Software Revolution: Enter Bill Gates
3:42 The Trillion-Dollar Milestone: Elon Musk & SpaceX
4:53 Has the Wealth Ceiling Been Obliterated?

Read the full story on Forbes: https://www.forbes.com/sites/chasewithorn/2026/06/11/from-rockefeller-to-musk-the-wealth-boom-thats-leading-to-the-fi
title: The Road To The First Trillionaire: How American Wealth Exploded
